model.name: FeatureManager.grantFeature
model.description: grantFeature(featureName, token): HARDCODED-owner-gated write (root-of-trust, NOT data-driven — closes self-grant escalation). Adds token to Feature.allowedUsers AND mirror-maintains profile.features (both sides). Gated by ServerManagerGuard.assertOwner (the R31.2 OWNER_TOKEN literal). INV-F4: a non-owner grant attempt -> 403, never mutates. LOAD-BEARING marked decl. Architect design 83836631a.
